'''Tian''' is a [[Kandori]] soldier at [[Heeth Tower]], and son of the lady [[Yabeth]].

==Activities==
Tian is sent south, replacing [[Keemlin Rai]], as a messenger to warn the capitol of the [[Trolloc]] invasion.{{ref/book|13|p}}
